Main source-backed conclusions, each cited to exact file:line in the artifact: (1) status-mode file sections are ALREADY collapsed unconditionally (magit-diff.el:2779-2786), so the proposal's core behaviour is upstream default, not new work; (2) the observed screen was collapsed GROUP sections, the opposite of the assumed defect; (3) native M-2 already yields the overview shape and leaves untracked visible, but acts on magit-root-section and so overreaches past the change groups; (4) per-window folds are structurally impossible (buffer-wide invisible overlays plus a single hidden slot); (5) --stat is gated out of status buffers upstream (magit-diff.el:1252-1257, 1266-1268) and forcing it in would yield nil-valued colliding file section idents, so no statistics; (6) buffer size is a bad acceptance criterion because hunks are washed eagerly (magit-diff.el:2800) and collapsing only adds overlays. Addendum v2 records two concessions where the coordinator was right: my cache-preserving overview wrapper was WRONG (it would evaporate on the next refresh, since stale cached 'show' entries win at magit-section.el:1455-1470), and the command must be scoped to unstaged/staged rather than shadowing M-2. On update-002's question I verified BOTH halves: magit-restore-section-visibility-cache is called for every new Magit buffer (magit-mode.el:917) and is status-mode aware, but nothing populates its key for status buffers in this version -- the only kill-buffer-hook registration of magit-preserve-section-visibility-cache is in magit-refs.el:328 -- so the restore path is real in principle and inert in practice today. I recommend the spec define 'fresh' by the cache lookup rather than by buffer creation, which is correct either way. Sections 8 and 14 carry the open questions; section 8 question 2 is explicitly WITHDRAWN per update-003.

tests.result: PARTIAL. The two compared cases ran and agreed with the source reading: show-headings-1 and show-children-1 with depth nil both unhide unstaged, file AND hunk (byte-identical output), confirming that magit-section-show-headings does not keep hunk bodies hidden despite its docstring, and therefore that <backtab>/magit-section-cycle-global offers no intermediate overview state. The two further depth=0 and depth=1 cases in the same file ERRORED with wrong-type-argument (integer-or-marker-p nil), because magit-section-hide requires real markers in a real buffer; the depth arithmetic attributed to M-2 in the artifact is therefore source-derived, NOT probe-verified. This probe validates one narrow Elisp claim only. It is NOT evidence that the design recommendations are correct, that any acceptance criterion passes, or that the worktree is in any particular state.
